title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Realm of the Gods

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We face off against Silence Suzuka at the Takarazuka Kinen, and it looks like Manhattan Cafe manages to get even closer to her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surpassing her limits during the race, Manhattan Cafe catches a glimpse of the beyond. Shaken to hear this, Agnes Tachyon agonizes over the fact that she can't see such sights herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe believes her races with Silence Suzuka and Special Week were orchestrated by her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though we gave up on the international race, her friend continues to guide us… For now, I have no idea what this all means.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what is clear is that her friend is still with us. Knowing that, we settle on the Japan Cup for our next race.
